posts.title: Beyond the Agent Loop
posts.description: Building an AI agent used to mean building half a platform around it. Persistent sessions, context management, tool orchestration, recovery, subagents. The plumbing could be more work than the intelligence. OpenAI's Agents API changes that equation. And it raises an interesting question: what will developers build when they can finally stop building the machinery?

posts.title: AI Decision Models: From Reasoning to Action
posts.description: AI is learning to think. But can it make the right call? A new generation of decision models promises to turn AI from a generator of words into a component that makes structured, actionable judgments. From autonomous agents to automotive voice systems, this could fundamentally change how we architect software. The real opportunity may be closer than you think.

posts.title: A Million Apps, Not a Single New Idea
posts.description: AI can build almost anything in a weekend. But where are the new ideas? We are witnessing an explosion of software, celebrated as an unprecedented wave of innovation. Yet much of it is simply the reproduction of things that already exist. Have we entered an age of invention, or just industrialized imitation?
